name: Flight Results
description: Search summary with Modify, a ±3-day date strip, and the list of flight result cards with expandable fare options.

provenance.tag: Card structure: A · unverified. Fare family names: Official.

structure:
[Search summary bar: DXB → LHR · 12 Dec · 1 adult · Economy   [Modify]]
[Date strip: ±3 days with lowest fare per day]                  ← A · unverified ("lowest price preview per day")
[Results list]
  [FlightResultCard ×n]
     [Origin: time / IATA / city] [FlightPath: duration · stops] [Destination: time / IATA / city]
     [AircraftBadge] [from-price]   [Select ▼]
     [FareOptions (expanded): Economy Saver | Flex | Flex Plus | … ]

regions.name: Search summary bar
regions.description: Route, date, passengers, cabin and a Modify action (Button ghost) that opens the FlightSearchWidget overlay.

regions.name: Date strip
regions.description: ±3 days with the lowest fare per day.

source.tag: A · unverified ("lowest price preview per day")

regions.name: Results list
regions.description: FlightResultCard ×n, each with FlightSegment, AircraftBadge, from-price and Select ▼ → FareOptions.

responsive.behavior: Cards stack and the fare options open below the card.

rules: Fare family names (Official): Saver, Flex, Flex Plus for Economy; Special, Saver, Flex, Flex Plus for Business; First. File A's names ("Economy Special", "Economy Flex"…) are not used.
